name: start_chapter
description: Start the chapter: the recording plays (or the reading begins) as soon as the guide finishes its lead-in line. Reply with an empty message.

name: set_next_chapter
description: Record what tonight's chapter should be, once the guide has said aloud what it will make. Before the build starts the plan is rewritten (about a minute); after it, the request is saved for the next build day and the result says so.

mode.description: topic: a new topic or a different angle (say which in topic and notes); continue: go deeper on the last chapter; surprise: the guide picks; keep: leave the plan as it is.

topic.description: The topic or angle, in a sentence, in the listener's words where possible.

notes.description: Anything else they said to include or avoid, word for word where possible.

name: resume_chapter
description: End the aside and resume the recording, after the guide's few words leading back. Leave rewind out unless the listener seemed lost (then 'paragraph').

name: save_seed
description: Keep a topic for a future chapter, when a question deserves real research beyond this chapter.

topic.description: The topic, as a chapter could take it on, in a sentence.

why.description: Why it matters to the listener, in their words where possible.
